implemented: A content-addressed failed-break fade hypothesis has its own mechanism, payer, regimes, falsifier, timestamp contract, and intraday exit rule.
Candidate generation rejects naive, future, or not-yet-available timestamps and emits no quantity or order intent.
A dedicated cost budget requires entry/exit spread, fee, tax, impact and hashed effective-date fee schedule, then applies 1x/1.5x/2x stress with a 2x gross-to-cost hurdle.
The candidate is not added to the strategy registry or evidence ledger and is permanently labeled exploratory in this implementation.
